shape.description: Wide grey band (inner rim, slotted floor, high outer wall) of about three quarters of a turn, wrapping round the front corner of its host stack: its tongue rests on the host block's cup end (peg through the tongue slot), the band turns toward one side and falls one slot, and its far end lies on the cup end of the block under the host on that side face, clip on that face's tab. That lower block is turned 90 degrees, so the marble crosses it and leaves through the opposite side face. Nothing dips under the band; the curl seen inside the band in IMG_0959 is the band's own inner rim.
shape.sizeBasis: Scaled from the floor cell (about 45 mm, one block width) against VTech parts drawings and Joey's photos; +-10%. No ruler in any photo. Track width about 25 mm (straights) and 31 mm (curved bands), read against block width in IMG_0952/0953 and lp manual p5.

accepts: cup end of the host block
cup end of the block under the host, turned 90 degrees so its cup runs across (B-01, B-03, B-04)
tab of the block under the host on that same side face

physics.behaviour: Whirls the marble three quarters of the way round the front corner of its host stack and hands it, one slot lower, into the side of the block under the host. That block is turned 90 degrees, so the marble crosses it (a tunnel under the host) and leaves through the far side; a hole block there lets it fall on inside the tower.

evidence.shows: top view: tongue on the host's cup end with a peg through its slot; one band of about three quarters of a turn to the right; its end beside the host, clip on the lower block's side tab
end view: the lower block is turned 90 degrees (its cup and tabs run across), the band's end and clip on its side face
the band wraps the host stack's front corner; its end meets the side face of the lower block beside that block's arch
a single band of about 270 degrees, no inner coil
T-15 into blue, on grey B-03, on M-04, tan and red; T-17 clipped: hypothesis case
T-17 at I7 blue over M-04
T-17 on red over blue, top of low stack: plain tunnel case
the band wraps round its host block; the 1.25-turn coil with an under-tail was wrong

assumptions: Connection: the track end is a thin tongue that overlaps the next piece. A small slot in the tongue takes a small peg on that piece, and a hooked foot under the end drops into the block's side tab (photos IMG_0959, 0963; foot on trex_plans_02).
Entry at outer end and exit at tail come from the owner's photos and the chute feed; no plan arrow shows it.
Extraction's 'collector cup' is wrong: it passes the marble on.

Scale is estimated, not measured: one cell = one block width (top-down maps, trex_plans_27). A cell of about 45 mm is judged from hand and laptop-key size in IMG_0960/0963, +-5 mm. No ruler was in any photo.
Band centreline radius about 0.6 cell with short straight leads at both ends, read from IMG_0959 (outer wall about 1.9 block widths across); hand-held photos, +-0.1 cell.
The lower block is a straight block turned 90 degrees (IMG_0960); a corner block or B-02 there is not what the photos show.
openQuestions: Measure the band's outer diameter against a block to fix the radius.
